newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder calls calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder calls calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on both CME live and feeder cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent higher to 0.100 lower, livestock analysts said.

Further rolling of short positions was expected in live cattle futures as nearby fundamentals remain strong. Although cash wholesale boxed beef values were lower, sales were active and packers were considered short of slaughter ready numbers, analysts said.
Feedlots continued to hold asking prices firm in view of tight fed cattle supplies and packers may have to pay $72 to $73 per cwt to obtain cattle, they said.
Expectations of increased fed cattle supplies later in the year will likely keep pressure on deferreds, they said.

Feeder cattle futures could again follow the lead of live cattle with mixed fundamentals likely to bring uneven trade. Corn futures were called lower and could lend support while a lower index was viewed as negative, they added.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.19 at $63.55 per cwt.
